architectural-decision-records.why: records the scan-scope decision and the genesis invoke-preservation fix
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0061: --ignore scan-scope on the two code-scan gates so they travel without false-positives on the gate infra, plus the fix for genesis silently dropping invoke (which had broken every travelling gate in consumers)
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

arch-encode.why: two caught mistakes (genesis dropping invoke; invoke not being provenance-protected) were each turned into an enforced, tested rule
arch-encode.what: encoded the silent invoke-drop as a discriminating genesis test, and the invoke-tamper bypass as an invoke comparison in check-manifest-provenance.mjs with a four-way discrimination test
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

verifiable-quality-gates.why: every new flag and the genesis fix has a test proven to detect its absence
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added discriminating tests for --allow-empty, --ignore scope, anti-evasion anchoring, invoke preservation, and the invoke-tamper provenance check; verified each fails against the unfixed code and passes against the fix
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change is tested at unit level and end-to-end through genesis into a consumer
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests exercise the flag parsing and scope logic; the genesis integration test bootstraps a consumer and asserts invoke survives into its manifest so the gates can scan the consumer
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

judge-arch.why: the change is reviewed in fresh context against the four questions before done
judge-arch.what: ran judge-arch in fresh context; it caught a high-severity hole (invoke was not provenance/parity protected, so a consumer could set --ignore . to neuter both security gates and still pass); fixed by binding invoke to provenance and recorded the matrix in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

skeptical-audit.why: each claim here carries an evidence state and a re-runnable source, disconfirming case first
skeptical-audit.what: reproduced the invoke-tamper bypass live (honest --ignore scripts/ci exit 1 vs tampered --ignore . exit 0), confirmed provenance now flags it, and reverted each fix to prove its discrimination test goes red
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: edited the owasp lint gate; verified its security detection is unchanged after the scope change
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: added --ignore scoping to check-owasp-lints.mjs and confirmed it still catches alg:none and insecure cookies in product code (only the gate infra at scripts/ci is skipped), so the structural control is not weakened
quotes: The scenario checks one attack is blocked; the structural control

universal-browser-device-support.why: edited the UA-sniff gate so its enforcement travels to consumers and still detects in product code
universal-browser-device-support.what: added --ignore scoping to check-no-ua-sniffing.mjs and confirmed it still catches navigator.userAgent and brand-string tests in product code after skipping only the gate infra
quotes: This rule is enforced by a mechanical gate

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the gate-script + test change; the travelling-scope behavior is pinned as an executable scenario
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the behaviors (clean consumer stays green, a product-code violation turns the aggregator red, the gate infra is skipped, a decoy path is still scanned) are written as discriminating tests executed at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system/data architecture or service change; the manifest remains the single owner of gate args

pattern-selector.why: no new feature or pattern choice; this is a scoped bug fix plus a CLI flag on existing gates

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, or feature flag; manifest version already leads at unreleased 1.2.0 per ADR-0060

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; gate scripts and tests only
